subject: Renewal + Reserved Pool increase for Lumenix — credit ask
messages:
From: Ava Turner <ava.turner@lumenix.ai>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@lumenix.ai
Date: 2027-09-15T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal thoughts — expanding reserved pool and pricing credit request

Sean —

Quick note as we're starting renewal planning: Lumenix is seeing a 2.8x run rate increase in inference against production models (Q2 usage attached). We're planning to move from our current 4-GPU reserved pool to an 8-GPU pool and would like to lock a 12-month committed term. Procurement asked if Redwood can provide a renewal credit to offset the uplift in committed spend given the multi-quarter adoption curve.

Can you share what kinds of credit/one-time concessions you can provide for committed upsizes during renewal? Our timeline is tight — need an agreed commercial term by Oct 7 to align internal budget cycles.

Thanks,
Ava Turner
Head of Platform Engineering
Lumenix
Attachments: Lumenix_Usage_Q2.csv (csv)
From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Turner <ava.turner@lumenix.ai>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@lumenix.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-16T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal thoughts — expanding reserved pool and pricing credit request

Hi Ava —

Really appreciate the heads-up and congrats on the acceleration — excellent to see. We can definitely support an 8-GPU reserved pool with a 12-month commit. For credits: typical options are a one-time committed-uptick credit tied to the signed SOW or a stepped discount that phases in over the first 3 months.

To give you a concrete proposal, can you confirm expected steady-state throughput (tokens/sec or requests/min) and whether you plan sustained burst windows? Also sending internal approval path — I'll follow up with a formal proposal and, if needed, escalate for executive credit approval this week to meet your Oct 7 deadline.

Proposed next steps:
- Quick sync (30m) to align on throughput + SLA targets
- Draft SOW + pricing with conditional credit options
- Exec review if credit >15%

I can be available tomorrow 9–11am PT or Friday 1–4pm PT.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0198
From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-23T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal thoughts — expanding reserved pool and pricing credit request

Monica / Markus —

Forwarding Lumenix's ask. Key points:
- Current: 4-GPU reserved pool. Ask: move to 8-GPU reserved pool, 12-month term.
- Usage trend: ~2.8x QoQ growth; attached Q2 usage for context.
- Commercial ask: one-time renewal/expansion credit to smooth ramp. Procurement wants committed terms signed by Oct 7.

Numbers from my side (rough): incremental committed spend ~$420k ARR on the larger pool. Customer is seeking ~15–25% one-time concession to help bridge first 2 quarters. They're pitch-perfect reference customer and strategic for our midmarket vertical play.

Options I'm proposing:
A) One-time credit of 18% applied to first invoice after SOW execution (preferred by customer)
B) 12% immediate credit + 6% performance ramp-back if throughput targets are met by month 4
C) No credit, deeper onboarding package (free onboarding hours + extended observability retention)

Attachments: Lumenix_Usage_Q2.csv, Lumenix_SOW_v3.pdf, approval_matrix.xlsx

Asking for quick exec sign-off on option A or B this week so we can lock Oct 7. If you want, I can trim the ask to 15% to reduce approval friction.

Thanks — Sean
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-24T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal thoughts — expanding reserved pool and pricing credit request

Sean —

Thanks for the clear options. Given Lumenix's strategic role and the timing constraint, I'm supportive of a one-time credit, but we should cap at 18% and attach clear success metrics (throughput buckets) to any ramp-back language. Please confirm margin impact (rev/net of credit) and include SOW draft showing committed throughput + SLA language.

I'll route to finance and sales ops now; Markus, marking for your approval (quick read). Approval matrix attached.

-Monica
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal thoughts — expanding reserved pool and pricing credit request

Monica / Sean —

After reviewing the impact and risk, I approve a one-time 18% credit on the incremental committed uplift, conditional on these items:
1) Signed SOW with 12-month commit (SOW v3) executed by Oct 7.
2) Agreed throughput buckets and SLA in the SOW; will convert to ramp-back clauses if performance targets are missed.
3) HubSpot deal updated and DocuSign SOW link included in the record.

Sean — proceed with option A (18%) and bless the DocuSign. Finance will route the accounting treatment; Sales Ops, please prepare final SOW and DocuSign envelope (link below). I'll join the handoff call if needed.

DocuSign (prelim): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/to/LMX-SOW-v3
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deals/LMX-2027-REN-42

-Markus Klein
SVP, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
